message.content:
Here’s a quick list of well‑received documentaries you’ll want to check out if you’re interested in learning more about climate change (global warming) from different angles:

| Title | Release Year | Director(s) | Runtime | Where to Watch* |
|-------|--------------|-------------|---------|----------------|
| **“An Inconvenient Truth”** | 2006 | Davis Guggenheim | 115 min | Amazon Prime Video, iTunes, Google Play Movies |
| **“An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power”** | 2017 | Davis Guggenheim | 112 min | Netflix, Hulu, Amazon Prime Video |
| **“Before the Flood”** | 2015 | Fisher Stevens (producer), directed by Fisher Stevens & James Cameron | 90 min | Disney+, YouTube Premium, Apple TV+ |
| **“Climate Change – A Global Crisis”** (BBC Horizon episode) | 1999 | David Attenborough (presenter) | 60 min | BBC iPlayer, PBS (if available) |
| **“Our Planet”** (Season 1 Episode “Ice”) | 2019 | Alastair Fothergill, Mark Linfield | 45–50 min per episode | Netflix |
| **“Heat Death”** | 2020 | Daniel Kwan & Daniel Scheinert (the Daniels) | 86 min | HBO Max, Amazon Prime Video |

\*Availability may vary by region; use your local streaming service or digital rental platform to confirm.

### Quick Overview

| Documentary | Focus / Angle |
|------------|---------------|
| *An Inconvenient Truth* | Former U.S. Vice President Al Gore presents science behind climate change and policy solutions. |
| *An Inconvenient Sequel* | Updates on progress since 2006, new data, and calls for action. |
| *Before the Flood* | Travelogue/advocacy film featuring Leonardo DiCaprio exploring impacts worldwide. |
| *Climate Change – A Global Crisis* | Classic BBC program explaining mechanisms, evidence, and mitigation strategies. |
| *Our Planet* | Nature series highlighting how ecosystems will shift under rising temperatures. |
| *Heat Death* | Personal narrative blending art, music, and environmental activism. |

Feel free to let me know which one interests you most— I can give you a deeper synopsis, key takeaways, or help locate a specific copy!
